description: This file defines the 'Statistics' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve and manipulate statistics data stored in the database, such as getting all statistics, fetching a specific value, adding, removing, and editing values associated with statistical codes.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Model class for handling statistics data, including retrieval and update operations.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistic records from the database.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value corresponding to a specific statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value for a given statistic code.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value for a specific statistic code.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the given statistic code.
